sources.readScope: Structured Responses errors through end; preceding sections not reviewed

summaries.overview: Documents user-operated OSS/local/self-hosted plan sharing; remotely hosted/paid service goes through interest process. Stable opaque host identifier and account/workspace client mapping; fresh reply homes must not manufacture new logical hosts.
summaries.models: This SIWC flow uses public Responses, not backend-api. Current account catalog and terminal completed event matter; failure may arrive after stream begins.
summaries.accounts: Registrations and credentials stay separate even for same email; serialize rotating refresh. Usage page links to ChatGPT Settings Usage; account/app-wide limits are shared. No numerical quota feed is established by that documentation.
summaries.limitations: storefalse/streamtrue/stateless bounded HTTP inputs required; max_output_tokens unsupported. This is a cap-qualification constraint, not permission to change routes or billing.
summaries.errors: App-specific usage-limit errors do not prove entire subscription empty or reset time. Preserve machine codes, current credential/uncertain outcome and bounded recovery.

inference: Installed fixed-client backend route cannot be called the documented app-specific SIWC route without separate qualification. Missing cap field is observed offline; effective provider hard limit/topology/entitlement/remaining-cap telemetry are unqualified.
